name: Chocolate Caramels
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Put butter into kettle; when melted, add molasses, sugar, and milk.
Stir until sugar is dissolved, and when boiling-point is reached, add chocolate, stirring constantly until chocolate is melted.
Boil until, when tried in cold water, a firm ball may be formed in the fingers.
Add vanilla just after taking from fire.
Turn into a buttered pan, cool, and mark in small squares.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
